title: Self-Pay Visit Package Payments, Installments and Visit Crediting
content:
**Policy.** Payments on a Self-Pay Visit Package are taken by card, cash, check, or an HSA or FSA card where the tier accepts HSA and FSA cards. The money the patient has paid toward a package — installments of the price and reinstatement fees — net of refunds is the package's amount paid; the visits credited to it that have not yet been redeemed, forfeited, expired, transferred or refunded are its visits remaining. The package is activated when its first (or only) payment is received.

**Installments.** Where the tier allows installments and the patient chose installments:

- the clause that the purchase price is split into the tier's number of equal installments, the last absorbing any cent of rounding, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the amount of an installment;
- the first installment is due on the purchase date, and each later one the tier's installment interval in calendar days after the previous due date;
- each installment paid credits the tier's visits included divided by its number of installments;
- where the tier requires a card kept on file, installments after the first are drafted automatically from the card kept on file on their due dates;
- an installment unpaid the tier's late-days figure in calendar days after its due date stops further crediting until it is paid.

**Payment in full.** Where installments are not used, the payment in full credits all visits.

**Reinstatement fee.** A reinstatement fee credits back the visits that expired.

**Ceiling on payments.** Payments never exceed the purchase price plus any reinstatement fee taken together.

**Crediting at a glance**

| Payment received | Visits credited |
|---|---|
| One installment of a package paid in installments | visits included divided by the number of installments |
| Payment in full | all visits included |
| Reinstatement fee | the visits that expired |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a package of 12 visits paid in 2 installments credits 6 visits on each installment paid; a package of 24 visits paid in 3 installments credits 8 visits on each. A package whose installment interval is 30 calendar days and whose purchase date is day 0 has its second installment due on day 30 and its third on day 60.

superseded_clauses: the purchase price is split into installment_count equal installments (the last absorbing any cent of rounding)
